notes.title: Have You Played… Blood Bowl 2?
notes.notes:
Have You Played? is an endless stream of game retrospectives. One a day, every day, perhaps for all time.

If Graham allowed us to swear above the cut, I would one hundred percent have started this post with a string of expletives. Because Warhammer-themed sports game Blood Bowl 2 is utterly maddening. I’m playing in a league at the moment, the bottom of which I am hugging like a flipping anchor, and while the people I’m playing with are great, I dread every fixture as two hours I know I will never get back. The losing, I couldn’t care less about. I am not really very competitive about games anyway, and as a newcomer to this one, it’s only natural that I’d get repeatedly mauled by a league full of more experienced players. Oh no. The problem, crucially, is the anatomy of a Blood Bowl 2 loss.

notes.title: How Blood Bowl PC fanatics are taking player-run leagues to the extreme
notes.notes:
Blood Bowl was originally a tabletop miniatures game released by that most holy of British institutions, Games Workshop, back in the '80s. Yet it wasn't until the third edition dropped in 1994 that Blood Bowl became recognisable as the game it is today. It's set in a version of the Warhammer Fantasy Universe where the many opposing races have decided to lay down their arms and settle their differences by trying to score touchdowns.

As such, it exists as both a parody of medieval fantasy tropes and as an irreverent jab at the ridiculousness of modern, organised sport. Your players will sometimes steal funds from the team's treasury, violent fans will invade the pitch and injure your squad at half-time, and referees can be bribed before each game to ignore fouls and concealed weapons. The reason I'm telling you this is because I want to impress upon you just how silly Blood Bowl is. It's basically a filthy, sporty Discworld and most of its players are in on the joke.

What's more, Blood Bowl is designed to be played over time. Individual players will accrue 'star player points' each time they successfully complete passes, make interceptions, cause casualties and score touchdowns. They eventually level up and gain access to new skills and stat increases, providing a real sense of progression. It's not uncommon for your Wood Elf lineman or Dwarven blitzer to go from a mewling wuss to an unstoppable juggernaut over the course of a season, only for them to end up getting permanently removed from the game when seven or eight Halflings decide to gather round and jump all over their face.

I play a Vampire team in the Cup, chosen for high str, high ag players with a range of tactical opportunities through hypnotic gaze. Simple, safe build with 4 vampires with block, 1 also with tackle and a leader thrall for 5 RR and and apo.

[b][i]Tell us about your history with Blood Bowl. When did you start playing, what's your best memory?[/i][/b]

I started playing Blood Bowl on Xbox when it came out as it reminded me of Chaos League (a game I loved as a kid), didnt really get hooked until Blood Bowl 2 was released though, as soon as i found the CCL, I've been playing religously ever since! Highlight would be winning the cup in season 9!

[b][i]A word for your opponents?[/i][/b]

I'd just like to apologise in advance and wish them all luck!

[h1][b]Enarion[/b][/h1]

Avid BB Addict since the late 1980’s. Father of two, 3 and 1, got a wife, house, dog etc. Which means finding time to play BB nowadays is a bit hard.

[b][i]What's your team, why did you choose it and what build do you use?[/i][/b]

Wood Elves. Simply because it’s the team I enjoy the most to coach closely followed by the little Halfling buggers.

[b][i]Tell us about your history with Blood Bowl. When did you start playing, what's your best memory?[/i][/b]

Sitting in my childhood room playing Blood Bowl vs my friend while “Like a Virgin” was on the repeat. ***Chuckles*** Quite depressing albeit humourus! Been an off and on BB addict ever since.

[b][i]A word for your opponents?[/i][/b]

Good luck and most importantly... have fun! 

[h1][b]Sean-18[/b][/h1]

Hello my name is Sean. I'm 21 and I'm known in the Blood Bowl community for having hair, something much of the Blood Bowl community can only dream of. I live in the UK and work part time as a bar man and a tutor (drunk people are definitely more annoying than kids).

[b][i]What's your team, why did you choose it and what build do you use?[/i][/b]

My team is chosen to try and hard counter the biggest threat I will face on my journey in this format. Wood Elves. Dwarves have ample block and tackle which will give me good opportunities to frustrate players with dodge and take them down efficiently without spending any of my valuable 4 skills.

3 Guard both allows me to gain a blocking advantage and to protect my ball from any leap 1 dice attempts on my ball carrier and 2 runners means 2 sets of sure hands for recovering the ball which is where the game will be won and lost. 

With that the added threat of the mighty blow troll slayer should  be the star man not only due to his great hair but his ability to grind down opponents and give me the man advantage that should let me get over the line. My team should still have ample tools to deal with any other bash teams (namely guard and ofc block) I may face but the main focus is to counter wood elves.

[b][i]Tell us about your history with Blood Bowl. When did you start playing, what's your best memory?[/i][/b]

I started playing Blood Bowl when I noticed it advertised on Steam shortly after it came out and I have been fascinated with it in an on/off love/hate way for some time. The premise of turn based strategy with a variety of options that provide different pros and cons with differing success rates is an unsolvable enigma that can be debated on the internet forever.

Shortly after buying the game and playing for a while I discovered Blood Bowl on Twitch by virtue of playing someone who was streaming and decided to take part in the never ending debates about Orc Throwers and Nerves of Steel. It's a fantastic community who are some of the funniest guys you won't meet (because they'll be at home) and there are plenty of opportunities to play and have fun (or watch when you inevitably burn out). 

I ended up streaming a lot of Blood Bowl (and hope I have provided some memorable moments) due more than anything to the community that follows blood bowl on Twitch.

[b][i]A word for your opponents?[/i][/b]

My team is called UNLUCKEEEEE for a reason. If you face me consider yourself UNLUCKEEEEEE. Also if I end up facing Enarion's Wood Elves then sorry not sorry Enarion. 

[h1][b]Diomlord[/b][/h1]

Hi everyone, I'm Lorenzo alias Diomlord and I'm 26. I live in Italy and in real life i am preparing for the State exam to become a lawyer. I have a girlfriend from Chile that brings me fortune in the game, as I will tell you later.

I have also done a lot of sports in this year, at the moment I am a football referee. I have always played a lot of videogames while in the last few years me and my friends got more near to the tabletop and miniatures games. Then we found that BLOODBOWL IS OUR GAME !!!

[b][i]What's your team, why did you choose it and what build do you use?[/i][/b]

My main team is and will always be ORC. It all began with Warcraft III and then World of Warcraft (don't know if I can quote them) where my character was "Diomlord", an orc warrior. We played it for some years and then changed a lot of games, but from there I will always bring my nickname and the proud to be an ORC !!!

For the team I will go with: Troll, 4 BOB, 4 blitzers, trower, lineman, goblin + APO and 2 rerolls and 2 Fan Factor; skills will be:  mb blitzer, mb + tackle blitzer, leader trower.

[b][i]Tell us about your history with Blood Bowl. When did you start playing, what's your best memory?[/i][/b]

I started playing about 2 years ago. Starting from the videogame, I found a league here in Pisa that plays tabletop bloodbowl. From that moment i have always played both online and "offline". It's only 2 years but I have a lot of memories that I can tell you: the first tournament won in Lucca one week after the relationship with my girlfriend was started, the "incredible" win of the Champion cup X with the support of my friends, the emotion to win the Dungeonbowl at Dusseldorf, one of the majors and probably the most important tournament in Europe. 

Now that I am the top Orc in the world by NAF rankings, my next goal is to take part at the BB2 WORLD CUP 2018 and do my best there!!!

[b][i]A word for your opponents?[/i][/b]

The words for my opponents are "Rotto senza, CAS, LEVA!!!" that in English mean "broken without (without mighty blow), Casualty, remove (remove the player from the board)!!!"

[h1][b]Pupok[/b][/h1]

My name is Evgeny and im from Siberia. Playing and streaming Blood Bowl for fun.

[b][i]What's your team, why did you choose it and what build do you use?[/i][/b]

I choose Humans because its universal strong team for this format. Build with 1 tacke and mass guards.

[b][i]Tell us about your history with Blood Bowl. When did you start playing, what's your best memory?[/i][/b]

Buy this game at september 2015, play a little bit and then have a 2 years break. Then saw this game on a stream and start playing again, and play alot in this year. I won Play-Off of ladder that was best memory in this game.

[b][i]A word for your opponents?[/i][/b]

Just have fun. If you cant find fun in this game delete the game.

[h1][b]Arzowane[/b][/h1]

I´m a 31 years old spanish player from Barcelona, really addict to strategy games. I´m a psychologist so I know in advance the thoughts of my opponents. I´m so competitive but I like the fair game, and I respect so much my opponents. Always trying to have fun in every match, it´s the only way not to have a heart attack!

[b][i]What's your team, why did you choose it and what build do you use?[/i][/b]

I have chosen Humans because they can be competitive according to the tournament rules. I tried to balance the team with 3 guards and a killer. I have tried to looked for a team which have access to 12 players and an apo and basic abilities as sure hands, block or tackle. I like humans because they can defend so well with their mobility and score in a few turns if it´s necessary.

[b][i]Tell us about your history with Blood Bowl. When did you start playing, what's your best memory?[/i][/b]

I began playing with the launch of the BB2 for Ps4 and it was love at the first sight! From the beginning of the Cladder I classified in every season and I won it four times with four different teams, being so far the most successful player in PS4. Since the last month I´m also an administrator, knowing that i´m not going to win anymore due to the PS4 admin curse.

[b][i]A word for your opponents?[/i][/b]

Try to enjoy the match, and remember it´s just a game. Love and peace.

[h1][b]Crucifer[/b][/h1]

I am the guy who plays alot as many people who watch streams call me. Holding the record for most games played in CCL for the reason I really enjoy the game and format.

[b][i]What's your team, why did you choose it and what build do you use?[/i][/b]

I chose Chaos Dwarves because they are one of two races I play at the moment and pro elves are rather bad at this TV. I thought humans are best but lack of experience with them was a huge problem for me in league World Cup qualifiers. I think it is bad at this tv too so I chose to use experiemental build with 2 RRs and Mino not because I expect it to work, but because I hope it might work.

[i]Tell us about your history with Blood Bowl. When did you start playing, what's your best memory?[/i]

I started playing couple of ears ago and it was like an addiction at first, many restarts, many concedes with orcs and alot of frustration, more than fun actually. Best memory is when I found myself in playoffs first time and first victory in finals, first because of sudden feel of achievement, second because it felt like a huge prize and some kind of glory maybe.

[b][i]A word for your opponents?[/i][/b]

Some of them I almost don't know, some are rivals for very long time now, meaning Pupok and Diomlord. And Enarion is the guy I have most respect for in BB. He was the first guy who I matched against and knew by name. The guy who was the reason I began streaming a year ago and the guy who plays so fast and precise with his elves that it feels like magic.

[h1][b]Bernie Buffon[/b][/h1]

Hi Everyone My name is Lee aka Bernie Buffon, Nickname The Curse Of Bernie (Due to whatever I tip usually gets diced and goes crashing out of the cup). Im from England and a proud Yorkshiremen Big sports fanatic and favourite sport is American Football. I stream for PS4 and Xbox one mainly Champions ladder and streamed alot of the finals.

[b][i]What's your team, why did you choose it and what build do you use?[/i][/b]

I went with the Oberwalds for purely fun and story purpose really. One season i took a 6 game bret team to the final led by Griff Oberwald and thought it would be fitting to do a human team where his sons all 12 of them (Busy Man) represent me and bring some of that oberwald magic to the invitational. 

[b][i]Tell us about your history with Blood Bowl. When did you start playing, what's your best memory?[/i][/b]

Played Bloodbowl for over 20 years now and love the game, Used to work for games workshop back in the day and loved promoting and teaching people the wonderful game of bloodbowl. 

Best memory is a tough one Turn 25 in opening game of season 1 in first ever champions ladder game where i tried to score turn 25 in overtime and then get knocked out by a tree kicking a penalty goal was funny and from that came Bernie Buffon so i guess that is best memory that is when Bernie Buffon had arrived on the season for all the wrong reasons lol. We still have fun with that today ive just made the season 15 Final with the dwarfs with team called Turn 25 Never Forgotten.

[b][i]A word for your opponents?[/i][/b]

What you gonna do when Bernie Buffon Tips YOU!!!

notes.title: Bigben buying Styx & Blood Bowl devs Cyanide Studio
notes.notes: French publishers Bigben Interactive are buying French developers Cyanide Studio, the mob behind games including Styx sneak ’em ups, the Blood Bowl adaptation, and the Game Of Thrones RPG. Cyanide’s games tend not to quite come together while being interesting or admirable in their ambition, mid-budget games of a sort we don’t see much any more – I’m always interested to see what they’re up to. Bigben are glad to be getting a development studio of their own, while Cyanide say this will help them expand and make better games. (more…)

notes.title: Bug Fixes Update 3.0.210.1
notes.notes:
[img]http://cloud-3.steamusercontent.com/ugc/922542965620491567/6ADAC43E9D8FD60EC761C53FA2015DCB7C841718/[/img]

[b]We're pleased to announce the release of a new update for Blood Bowl 2 on PC/Mac![/b]

This patch features bug fixes based on your feedback since the release of the last update, a few months ago.

Thanks again for your help!

[h1][b]Update 3.0.210.1[/b][/h1]

[b]Multiplayer[/b]
[list][*]Fixed a desync issue with the timer that could skip the end of a choice for the active player before it visually ends.
[*]Getting disconnected during the inducements phase will let the player reconnects instead of kicking him on the main menu.
[*]In ladder, the text about added TV during the search for Goblin and Halfling has been removed (the effect itself has been removed in a previous patch).
[*]The reroll timer is now properly displayed for the opponent in multiplayer.
[*]Fixed a bug preventing the browsing of pages in manuel seeding with more than 16 teams.
[*]Player positional names are now displayed in the advanced management screen in multiplayer league.
[*]Fixed an exploit allowing to hire several times the same journeyman.
[*]Fixed an issue during the validation of a multiplayer match against an AI.
[*]To avoid a potential duplicate matchup in Wissen Mode with a low number of coaches, the maximum possible days is now the following:
[list][*]10 teams : 5 max days
[*]12 teams : 6 max days
[*]14 teams : 7 max days
[*]16 teams : 8 max days
[*]18 teams : 9 max days
[*]20 teams : 10 max days
[*]32 teams : 12 max days
[*]64 teams : 14 max days
[*]128 teams : 16 max days[/list][/list]
[b]Skills & Gameplay[/b]
[list][*]Fixed a bug causing the Leader skill to give 2 additional reroll instead of 1 on specific cases.
[*]A player stunned by the "Throw a Rock" event shouldn’t stay one extra turn stunned anymore.
[*]The Wizard spell won’t apply the Mighty Blow bonus on the Armor roll and on the Injury roll.
[*]The Goblin Fanatic isn’t able to use Multiple Block anymore, as written in LRB6.
[*]The Stakes skill should now work properly against the mixed team Afterlife United.
[*]Fixed a potential exploit allowing Throw Team-mate to be used on a player not located next to the thrower.
[*]Fixed a crash caused by an interaction between the skills Blood Lust and Dump-Off.
[*]Improvement of the GUI when the skills Multiple Block and Dauntless interact together.
[*]Rerolling the Chainsaw kickback during a foul now properly checks the Loner skill on the Chainsaw player instead of the fouled one.
[*]Fixed a bug of Throw Team-mate that didn’t trigger a turnover if the thrower player had the ball and land on an opposing player.
[*]Players of the defensive coach won’t use Diving Catch during the kickoff anymore.
[*]Fixed a potential freeze of the game during an interaction between Diving Tackle, Tackle and Dodge with the manuel skills.
[*]Dump-off can now be used during the first turn of the player on offense if the ball has been caught during the Blitz event.[/list]
[b]Management[/b]
[list][*]Personal stats reward the thrower for the yards of a pass and not the catcher anymore.
[*]On the post-match dice roll tab, armor/injury rolls have been inverted: for example, the armor roll is noted as Success if the armor didn’t broke. Those rolls are still assigned to the team suffering the block. In addition, Piling On is not considered anymore as a roll on its own but as a standard armor roll.[/list]
[b]Singleplayer[/b]
[list][*]Solo saves during a match now save which player did the kick-off in the 1st half-time.
[*]Fixed a blocking issue caused by an AI Leap in some specific cases.
[*]Ageing is off in Eternal League.
[*]Fix of the Resurrection mode in the Franken Cup during an Eternal League.
[*]Improvement of the transition after a defeat in a Knockout competition during an Eternal League.[/list]
[b]Graphics[/b]
[list][*]Fixed animations of the Goblin Bombardier which could cause a blocking issue.
[*]The team sponsor now appears on the global roster page.
[*]Fixed a missing arm on Grim Ironjaw during his touchdown celebration.
[*]Fixed a display bug on players hair when they have a helmet.
[*]Team sponsors logo of the Home player are now displayed on the stadium (behind the touchdown line).
[*]Fixed a bug which could prevent the Looney cutscenes to be played.
[*]Fixed animations of Throw Team-mate with the Troll from the Goblin team.[/list]
[b]Misc[/b]
[list][*]Decrease of replay files size.
[*]The special introductions of certain Starplayers (Morg, Eldril) from the campaign won’t appear anymore in the others game modes.
[*]The game will now better take into account the preselected square after the block dice choice during a chainpush.[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4664969/02407d1a4ad28770252f1bd5c14aadd227f1f0d2.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Major Bug Fix Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4664969/02407d1a4ad28770252f1bd5c14aadd227f1f0d2.jpg[/img]

Hey Coaches,

We're pleased to release a major bug fix update for Blood Bowl 2!

This update should fix most of the remaining technical issues of the game. Thanks for all the feedback and reports we received on our forum, it's been incredibly helpful to deliver this huge patch. Keep them coming!

The official Blood Bowl 2 competition, the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/236690/discussions/0/1474222595308625746/]Champion Ladder[/url] Season 9, will end tomorrow 10.00 AM CEST. Season 10 will start tomorrow around 4.00 PM CEST, after a PC/Mac maintenance. Good luck to all of you!

You'll find the (big) patch note below:

[h1][b]FEATURES[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Injuries are now displayed on the player cards.
[*]The Fan Factor is now displayed in the dice log when rolling the FAME.
[*]In the post match recap, the block dice picked by the defender are now displayed in red (as in game).
[*]Two new sponsors are available (cosmetic only).
[*]Mid-match saves aren't deleted when loading the match anymore, but at the end of the game.[/list]
[h1][b]GAME MODES[/b][/h1]

[b]Eternal League[/b]
[list][*]The skills from players in AI teams are now properly taken into account in the team TV. Not retroactive.
[*]The AI now also picks Bretonnia, Chaos Dwarf, Vampire, Kislev and Underworld teams.
[*]Fix of an issue displayed GFIs during AI movements.
[*]Fix of an issue preventing the AI from adapting its TV to the player TV.
[*]Fix of the statistic tab of teams playing in an Eternal League.
[*]Fix of an issue in the "Play in a League" menu after a season change.
[*]Fix of a blocking issue when a coach leaves an on-going wissen competition.[/list]
[b]Multiplayer[/b]
[list][*]The pairing in a Wissen competition starts now with the best ranked teams in the leaderboard.
[*]Game played in resurrection mode don't award SPP and gold anymore.
[*]The winnings window shouldn't be displayed anymore at the end of a game in resurrection mode.
[*]The tie-breaker in Round-Robin and Wissen competitions is now:
TD difference > Number of TD > Random[/list]
[h1][b]GAMEPLAY[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Fix of a blocking issue when ignoring the apothecary during the kick-off event Throw A Rock.
[*]Fix of a desync of the ball after a fireball combined with a scatter out of the pitch.
[*]Fix of a bug causing KO rolls during Overtime to be rolled twice.
[*]Fix of a bug causing Sweltering Heat rolls during Overtime to be rolled twice.
[*]Fix of an issue skipping the coin toss at the beginning at overtime.
[*]Fix of a bug allowing the player to use team reroll to catch the ball during Blitz! kick-off event.
[*]A player loosing a stat point when already at the minimum now misses the next game.
[*]Fix of an issue allowing to choose any skill on a big guy level up.
[*]Fix of an issue allowing to hire any player from any race in a standard team.
[*]Fix of an issue allowing to have too many skills on a level 2 mercenary.[/list]
[h1][b]STABILITY[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Fix of a crash when reconnecting in a match.
[*]Fix of various crashes in replays.
[*]Level 2 mercenaries shouldn't cause blocking issues anymore.
[*]Fix of various issues and crashes.[/list]
[h1][b]GUI[/b][/h1]
[list][*]Fix of the % of players coming back from a KO in the post-match recap.
[*]Fix of an issue blocking a player in the settings when the opponent pauses the game.
[*]The planning of a competition is now properly updated after a mnual seeding.
[*]Fix of a bug pausing the game when saving a starting set-up.
[*]The halfling chef pop-up is now properly displayed at the beginning of the second half time.
[*]The SPP gained before a save & quit won't be displayed at the wrong time anymore after reloading.
[*][MAC] The cyrillic characters are now properly displayed when the game isn't set up in russian.[/list]
[h1][b]SKILLS[/b][/h1]

[b]Pass Block[/b]
[list][*]The game now takes properly into account the square of the thrower, even if he moved in the turn.[/list]
[b]Bombardier[/b]
[list][*]Fix of a crash when rerolling a bomb reception.
[*]You can't use Bombardier after Jump Up anymore.
[*]You can't use Hail Mary Bomb during a Blizzard anymore.[/list]
[b]Juggernaut[/b]
[list][*]Juggernaut now properly cancels the opponent Wrestle when blitzing.
Juggernaut isn't displayed anymore in the dice recap at the end of the match.[/list]
[b]Diving Tackle[/b]
[list][*]The malus of Diving Tackle is now properly applied when using Dodge in manual mode.[/list]
[b]Leader[/b]
[list][*]Leader reroll cannot be canceled anymore by the Hafling Master Chef inducement.
[*]Leader reroll is now properly removed when the player with the skill is crowdsurfed.[/list]
[b]Leap[/b]
[list][*]Fix of an issue causing the game to roll two GFIs instead of one when a GFI is needed for a Leap.[/list]
[b]Really Stupid[/b]
[list][*]A player with Really Stupid skill cannot help the roll of another Really Stupid player.
[*]The bonus brought by a teammate (+2) is now properly displayed in the detailed dice log.[/list]
[b]Blood Lust[/b]
[list][*]Blitz isn't used anymore if it is followed by the bite of a teammate.
[*]When triggering "Bite a Teammate" with a vampire, he now gets up automatically before biting.[/list]
[b]Prehensile Tail[/b]
[list][*]The penalties are now added if several playerd with Prehensive Tail are next to a player dodging.[/list]
[b]Chainsaw[/b]
[list][*]It's now possible to reroll the Kick Back roll of a Chainsaw when fouling.[/list]
[b]Ball&Chain[/b]
[list][*]Improved game behaviour if the turn ends when the fanatic has some mandatory movements left.
[*]Fix of a bug preventing players from rolling a ball reception if it scatters because of Ball&Chain.
[*]The fanatic is now properly removed from the pitch after a KO on a Both Down.
[*]Fix of a blocking issue when a fanatic rolls 2 red dice against a teammate.[/list]
[b]Right Stuff[/b]
[list][*]The player now properly spend 3 movement points to get up if he landed on an opponent player.
[*]Fix of a bug causing a turnover when a player lands on the ball on the pitch.[/list]
[b]Stab[/b]
[list][*]When blitzing, refusing to use Stab on the second block of Frenzy doesn't end the player action anymore if (s)he has some movement points left.[/list]
[b]Multiple Block[/b]
[list][*]It's not possible anymore to use the second block of Multiple Block after a Piling On.
[*]The strength bonus given to the defender when using Multiple Block is now properly taken into account when combined with Dauntless.[/list]
[b]Strip Ball[/b]
[list][*]The skill is properly activated even when the ball carrier is pushed on a player using Stand Firm.[/list]
[b]Disturbing Presence[/b]
[list][*]Harmonization of the effect displayed:
[*]In multiplayer - always blue for the player and red for the opponent.
[*]In local - always blue for P1 and red for P2.[/list]
[h1][b]TEAMS[/b][/h1]

[b]Nurgle[/b]
[list][*]Nurgle Beast mutations are now back and displayed properly.
[*]Nurgle Beast should now stay quiet when not moving.[/list]
[b]Orc[/b]
[list][*]The Blitzers now have sounds (they're mainly shouting).[/list]
[b]Kislev[/b]
[list][*]Fix of an issue on the random name of the bear in russian, german, spanish and polish. Not retroactive.[/list]
[b]Goblin[/b]
[list][*]The Pogoer's 3D model should now be displayed properly when he's MVP.[/list]
[b]Khemri[/b]
[list][*]Khemri AI teams shouldn't be able to buy apothecaries. Not retroactive.[/list]
[b]Starplayers[/b]
[list][*]Fix of a crash when throwing the Star Player Bomber.
[*]It's not possible anymore to hire Brick & Grotty when there are already 15 players in the roster.[/list]
[b]Mixed Teams[/b]
[list][*]Fix of a display issue on the stats of mixed teams players in the customization screen.
[*]The Necromancer is now available for Afterlife United.[/list]
[b]Custom Teams[/b]
[list][*]Adding an injury to a player in the Team Editor doesn't add him a level anymore.[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix - Sept 11th 2017
notes.notes:
[img]https://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2017/37/1/1505134748-bb2le-bloodlust.gif[/img]
Hey Coaches,

We just released a hotfix on PC/Mac. This first update fixing the most urgent technical issues will arrive on Xbox One and PS4 in a couple of days.

Please find the patchlog below.

[h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1]
[list][*][FIXED] A bug can prevent a new season from happening in the Eternal League. Please note that the fix isn't retroactive. You'll have to restart an Eternal League if you encountered it.
[*][FIXED] 4 High Elf logos are missing: teams using these logos have invisible players (except the head).
[*][FIXED] [MAC only] The text displayed could be altered or even unreadable.
[*][FIXED] The game can freeze entirely against AI when using a specific interaction with the escape key.
[*][FIXED] [MAC only] Cyrillic characters aren't displayed properly for players not playing in russian.
[*][FIXED] The Necromantic team has access to 4 ghouls in its roster instead of a maximum of two.
[list][*]It still displays a maximum of four ghouls, but the actual limit is two. We'll update the number displayed in the patch.[/list][/list]
[b]We're already working on another bigger update for bug fixes.[/b] We'll dedicate the next few weeks to fixing as many issues as possible, before building a new version that includes fixes and releasing it. Our current target release for the first major bug fixing update is early October.

Your continuous feedback in the coming weeks will be incredibly helpful for us to test and reproduce any problem you might have encountered - please keep posting your feedback!

[img]https://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2017/37/1/1505134737-bb2le-logo-kislev-screens05.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update on Post-Launch Support
notes.notes:
[img]https://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2017/29/4/1500545316-bb2le-orkscheerleaders.gif[/img]
Hey Coaches,

Blood Bowl 2: Legendary Edition launches two days ago and we are very happy to see so many of you enjoying it - [b]you're almost as many to bash, score and throw teammates, as right after the initial launch of Blood Bowl 2![/b]

We're also delighted to announce that [b]we've just reached the 10 millionth touchdown scored in Blood Bowl 2![/b] Thanks again to all of you - we would have never reached this milestone without your enthusiasm and incredible commitment to the game!

[img]https://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2017/36/4/1504791181-bb2le-logo-kislev-screens04.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Post-Launch Support[/b][/h1]

We're aware that the recent launch has also introduced some new technical issues. We're reading your feedback and reports on our forum, Steam Hub and social networks and we're working hard to fix these issues as quickly as possible.

[b]We're planning an initial hotfix early next week[/b] to fix four urgent issues:
[list][*]A bug can prevent a new season from happening in the Eternal League.
[*]4 High Elf logos are missing: teams using these logos have invisible players (except the head).
[*][MAC only] The text displayed could be altered or even unreadable.
[*]The game can freeze entirely against AI when using a specific interaction with the escape key.[/list]
[b]And we're already working on an update for bug fixes[/b]. We'll dedicate the next few weeks to fixing as many issues as possible, before building a new version that includes fixes and releasing it. Our current target release for the first major bug fixing update is early October.

Your continuous feedback in the coming weeks will be incredibly helpful for us to test and reproduce any problem you might have encountered - please keep posting your feedback!

[img]https://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2017/36/4/1504791227-bb2le-logo-vampires-screens04.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Champion Ladder Season 9?[/b][/h1]

Based on the plans presented above, we have a decision to make concerning the Champion Ladder, our official competitive ladder.

Many of you have asked when the Champion Ladder Season 9 will open, we have two options for this competition and we'd like to have your opinion!

You'll find a poll below between 2 options:
[list][*]Starting Tuesday 12th a Champion Ladder Season 9 without money on the line. Only Cyans. Prize pool with actual money would come back in season 11, in 6 weeks.
[*]Wait for the first major bug fix update to start Champion Ladder Season 9, with a prize pool.[/list]
This poll is a tool for us to gather your feedback about this topic and see if there is a vast preference for a specific option. [b]Keep in mind that it's only a poll, it doesn't mean we'll necessarily go with the most upvoted option.[/b]

[url=https://strawpoll.com/pwwsfcx1][img]https://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2017/36/4/1504791290-capture.png[/img][/url]

[b]End of the poll[/b]: Monday 11th September

Have fun on the pitch,
Netheos

[b]We're planning an initial hotfix early next week[/b] to fix four urgent issues:
[list][*]A bug can prevent a new season from happening in the Eternal League.
[*]4 High Elf logos are missing: teams using these logos have invisible players (except the head).
[*][MAC only] The text displayed could be altered or even unreadable.
[*]The game can freeze entirely against AI when using a specific interaction with the escape key.[/list]

notes.title: Legendary Edition is coming!
notes.notes:
[img]https://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2017/06/1486634179-bb2-legendaryedition-logo.jpg[/img]

Hey coaches,

The [b]Legendary Edition of Blood Bowl 2[/b] has been announced at Le What's Next de Focus, our press event last week. We're pleased to finally unveil all the info about this new edition!

[h1][b]Release date[/b][/h1]

2017 – we’re aiming at this summer but depending on how the tests go, it may be delayed. We have some complicated features on the list (rez mode for example) and we want to implement them correctly. We'd prefer a slight delay than a messy launch.

[h1][b]Price[/b][/h1]
[list][*][b]For new players[/b]: the Legendary Edition with ALL the content of Blood Bowl 2 at the price of a full game. It contains:
[list][*] BB2 base game
[*][url=http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/2713/]Team Pack[/url] (Wood Elf/Lizardmen/Nurgle/Norse/Necromantic/Undead/Chaos Dwarfs/Khemri)
[*]Official Expansion.[/list][/list]
[list][*][b]For existing owners of BB2[/b]: the Official Expansion content for the price of a big DLC.[/list]

You'll still be able to purchase individual races if you wish.

[h1][b]Compatibility[/b][/h1]

[b]Full compatibility between the 2 versions.[/b] Most small features and quality of life changes will be available to all BB2 players, even those who didn't purchase the Official Expansion.

[h1][b]Content of the Official Expansion[/b][/h1]
[list][*][b]8 new races[/b]
[list][*]Amazons
[*]Goblins
[*]Vampires
[*]Ogres
[*]Halflings
[*]Pro Elves
[*]Underworld
[*]Kislev (based on the rules of Slanns)
[*][b]For a total of 24 races[/b] (the current 14 + Chaos Dwarfs + Khemri + 8 new)[/list][/list]
[list][*][b]Swiss system competition[/b][/list]
[list][*][b]Resurrection Mode[/b]
[list][*]No lasting SPP/injuries between each round.
[*]Evolution of teams between each round set in TV.[/list][/list]
[list][*][b]Team Editor[/b]
[list][*]Choose a race and get unlimited gold, as well as the option to add any skill/stat/injury.
[*]These teams get a tag “custom team” which can be banned from a league.
[*]Our goal with the combo “team editor + resurrection mode + Swiss system” is to give the opportunity to players to experience the rules played on tabletop.[/list][/list]
[list][*][b]New solo campaign mode[/b]
[list][*]Any race.
[*]Perpetual campaign.
[*]You have a map where you can go from a competition to another.
[*]Less cinematics/story and more freedom.[/list][/list]
[list][*][b]A brand new stadium based on the “Khemri” theme[/b][/list]
[list][*][b]Mercenary teams[/b]
[list][*]Teams composed of players picked from different races.
[*]Several groups of teams you can pick your players from (i.e “Elf team” = Pro Elf, WE, HE, DE).
[*]These teams will also have a specific tag – they won’t be allowed in Champion Ladder for example.[/list][/list]
[list][*][b]Star Player team[/b]
[list][*]Teams composed of 16 Starplayers.
[*]These teams will have a specific tag as well.[/list][/list]
[list][*][b]New chat tab in a league[/b]
[list][*]Accessible by all coaches with a team registered in the league.[/list][/list]
[list][*][b]Post-match chat[/b]
[list][*]You can discuss with your opponent even after the end of the game, as long as you stay on the “end of the match” screen.[/list][/list]
[list][*][b]Manual seeding in competitions.[/b][/list]
[list][*][b]Possibility to play a league with a mix of human players and AI teams.[/b][/list]
[list][*][b]AI enhancement[/b]
[list][*]The AI will now takes into account the current turn of the game (and not cross the pitch with dwarfs at turn 16).[/list][/list]
[list][*][b]Optional skills[/b]
[list][*]It’s been discussed a lot with the community – more skills will be optional (Kick, Pass, Grab, Side Step, Dodge, Tackle, Fend, Tentacles, Stand Firm, Break Tackle).[/list][/list]
[list][*][b]Free Camera Mode[/b][/list]
[list][*][b]Save during a singleplayer match.[/b][/list]
[list][*][b]Option to deactivate ageing in solo.[/b][/list]
[list][*][b]Enhanced Competition Administration[/b]
[list][*]Possibility to admin a match in details (to decide TDs, injuries, SPP…)[/list][/list]
[list][*][b]A pause system in multiplayer[/b]
[list][*]3 pauses per player per game.
[*]No time limit to a pause.
[*]Any player can unpause at anytime during a pause (even 5 seconds after a player paused).
[*]Players can use the chat during the pause.[/list][/list]
[list][*][b]FAME displayed during a match[/b][/list]
[list][*][b]New cheerleader models[/b] (not one per team, but a bit more diversity).[/list]
[list][*][b]Cheerleaders will have the same colors as the team they're supporting.[/b][/list]
[list][*][b]Option to display the tooltip in dices probability[/b] (“2+” instead of “83%”).[/list]
[list][*][b]A lot more Starplayers[/b]
[list][*]We aim at 50 Starplayers total.
[*]They won't all have a "premium skin" but we want to make them all available gameplay-wise.[/list][/list]
[list][*][b]Option to mute chat in match[/b][/list]

Hey coaches,

The [b]Legendary Edition of Blood Bowl 2[/b] has been announced at Le What's Next de Focus, our press event last week. We're pleased to finally unveil all the info about this new edition!

[h1][b]Release date[/b][/h1]

2017 – we’re aiming at this summer but depending on how the tests go, it may be delayed. We have some complicated features on the list (rez mode for example) and we want to implement them correctly. We'd prefer a slight delay than a messy launch.

[h1][b]Price[/b][/h1]
[list][*][b]For new players[/b]: the Legendary Edition with ALL the content of Blood Bowl 2 at the price of a full game. It contains:
[list][*] BB2 base game
[*][url=http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/2713/]Team Pack[/url] (Wood Elf/Lizardmen/Nurgle/Norse/Necromantic/Undead/Chaos Dwarfs/Khemri)
[*]Official Expansion.[/list][/list]
[list][*][b]For existing owners of BB2[/b]: the Official Expansion content for the price of a big DLC.[/list]

You'll still be able to purchase individual races if you wish.

[h1][b]Compatibility[/b][/h1]

[b]Full compatibility between the 2 versions.[/b] Most small features and quality of life changes will be available to all BB2 players, even those who didn't purchase the Official Expansion.

[list][*][b]8 new races[/b]
[list][*]Amazons
[*]Goblins
[*]Vampires
[*]Ogres
[*]Halflings
[*]Pro Elves
[*]Underworld
[*]Kislev (based on the rules of Slanns)

[list][*][b]Swiss system competition[/b][/list]
[list][*][b]Resurrection Mode[/b]
[list][*]No lasting SPP/injuries between each round.
[*]Evolution of teams between each round set in TV.[/list][/list]
[list][*][b]Team Editor[/b]
[list][*]Choose a race and get unlimited gold, as well as the option to add any skill/stat/injury.
[*]These teams get a tag “custom team” which can be banned from a league.
[*]Our goal with the combo “team editor + resurrection mode + Swiss system” is to give the opportunity to players to experience the rules played on tabletop.[/list][/list]
[list][*][b]New solo campaign mode[/b]
[list][*]Any race.
[*]Perpetual campaign.
[*]You have a map where you can go from a competition to another.
[*]Less cinematics/story and more freedom.[/list][/list]
[list][*][b]A brand new stadium based on the “Khemri” theme[/b][/list]
[list][*][b]Mercenary teams[/b]
[list][*]Teams composed of players picked from different races.
[*]Several groups of teams you can pick your players from (i.e “Elf team” = Pro Elf, WE, HE, DE).
[*]These teams will also have a specific tag – they won’t be allowed in Champion Ladder for example.[/list][/list]
[list][*][b]Star Player team[/b]
[list][*]Teams composed of 16 Starplayers.
[*]These teams will have a specific tag as well.[/list][/list]
[list][*][b]New chat tab in a league[/b]
[list][*]Accessible by all coaches with a team registered in the league.[/list][/list]
[list][*][b]Post-match chat[/b]
[list][*]You can discuss with your opponent even after the end of the game, as long as you stay on the “end of the match” screen.[/list][/list]
[list][*][b]Manual seeding in competitions.[/b][/list]
[list][*][b]Possibility to play a league with a mix of human players and AI teams.[/b][/list]
[list][*][b]AI enhancement[/b]
[list][*]The AI will now takes into account the current turn of the game (and not cross the pitch with dwarfs at turn 16).[/list][/list]
[list][*][b]Optional skills[/b]
[list][*]It’s been discussed a lot with the community – more skills will be optional (Kick, Pass, Grab, Side Step, Dodge, Tackle, Fend, Tentacles, Stand Firm, Break Tackle).[/list][/list]
[list][*][b]Free Camera Mode[/b][/list]
[list][*][b]Save during a singleplayer match.[/b][/list]
[list][*][b]Option to deactivate ageing in solo.[/b][/list]
[list][*][b]Enhanced Competition Administration[/b]
[list][*]Possibility to admin a match in details (to decide TDs, injuries, SPP…)[/list][/list]

notes.title: The Norse team is now available!
notes.notes:
[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/18/1462271195-norse-01.jpg[/img]

Hey Coaches,

Blood Bowl 2 welcomes a new race on its pitch: The Norse. The new screenshots show off the fearsome Norse players, their impressive Big Guy and their bestial Star Players - all included in the Norse DLC available today on PS4, Xbox One and PC. 

To respect the PC players of the first Blood Bowl game, which accumulated 23 races through 3 paying editions - we have heard their frustration - [b]we decided to create the FOUNDERS INCENTIVE for PC players of Blood Bowl 2: players will receive the Norse, the Undead, the Necromantic and the Nurgle teams for free, as long as they purchased the game before the races release.[/b]

[img]http://image.noelshack.com/fichiers/2016/18/1462271111-annonce-founder.jpg[/img]

Hailing from a far north peninsula of the Old World, Norsca, the Norse are fearsome warriors who naturally benefit from the Block skill – making a Norse line one of the more resilient Blood Bowl defensive walls. 

Norse players also have low Armour value, meaning they’re built for dishing out damage, not taking it. We’re excited to see how new Norse Coaches plan around the team’s weaknesses and exploit their strengths.

The Norse DLC pack includes new types of players, including the Ulfwerener. These werewolves encourage damage-dealing plays with their high Strength and their brutal Frenzy skill. 

The Norse Big Guy is the Yhetee, a vicious Snow Troll with Claws built for shredding high armoured players. Finally, two Star Players are joining the Norse: Icepelt Hammerblow, Yhetee, and Wilhelm Chaney, Ulfwerener.

Please find the full patchlog [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/236690/discussions/0/364040166691696039/]HERE[/url].

Have fun on the pitch,

notes.title: Info on the next Updates
notes.notes:
Hey Coaches!

It's been 2 months since the release of Blood Bowl 2 and we have released 4 patches and server updates on PC. We still have a lot to do and are constantly working to improve the game, including the addition of features and fixes based on your feedback, that's why we want to share our current objectives for the next patch.

It’s important to note that while we’re increasing transparency with the community, we can’t guarantee every feature we’re working on will make it into the patch. That said, feel free to give us your feedback on this list! We know it includes some features you guys were really hoping for.

Of course, we’re also working on other things, and there will be future patches, so don’t be disheartened if a feature you wanted didn’t make the list. Keep incontact with us, and maybe it’ll be in the next one!

[b]Main topics we are currently working on:[/b]

• Dice log history during the matches
• Juggernaut skill optional on "Both Down "
• Players placement phase accelerated (teleportation)
• Access to rosters during the inducements
• Option to display Player's names during the match
• Display the players missing the next game on the roster page
• Search tool for the replays
• Add more replays in Cabal TV (all those of the last 10 days)
• Option to change the options of an active league
• Option to display the grid during a match
• Reconnection to a match after a crash (PC only)
• Display fame and gold roll at the end of a match
• Server news displayed on the home page
• When buying players, display the price of a reroll
• Detailed stats for each player
• Option to validate a match in multiplayer competition (Round Robin, Knockout) without a commissioner
• Option to disable Jim & Bob subtitles
• Level up available for a team displayed on the shield of the team

We don’t have a date for this patch yet but as soon as we have something solid, we'll be happy to give you more info!

See you on the pitch!

notes.notes:

The beta of Blood Bowl 2 has launched! 

Join the many players already playing, and create your teams from the races currently available in this beta: Humans, Orcs, Skaven, and Dwarfs. All customised multiplayer leagues as well as teams created during the beta will be preserved... so you may start leveling up your favourite team without any regret! notes.title: WELCOME TO THE BETA
notes.notes:
Hello Blood Bowl coaches!

We’re excited to announce that the Blood Bowl 2 multiplayer beta is now live. That means you’re able to jump in and play the game right away and start earning XP for your coaches, and developing your teams. Yup, that means that your saves, teams, and coaches will not be deleted upon launch. 

The following content will be available during the multiplayer beta – and remember, it’s exactly that: a beta. We’d love to hear your feedback, technical issues, bug reporting and anything else you’d like to share with us. The right places to do that would be the Steam Hub and the game’s official forum. 

Content in the multiplayer beta:

• Four races: Orc, Humans, Dwarfs, and Skaven
• Friendly games, local, online – against AI or players
• Multiplayer leagues
• Management: team and league creation, levelling up, earning XP etc…
• Cabal TV (that’s the game’s replay mode to help you reflect on, and analyze, your game and games from other players).

Remember, this is a real beta so we really value your feedback. Play as much multiplayer as you can and create a league with your friend! There’s no NDA, so feel free to stream and discuss your impressions about the game online and with Focus and Cyanide who’ll be eagerly scanning over your feedback. There is a list of known issues that we’re working on before launch, and these are below:

• Some players might experience performance quirks depending on their hardware – still working on optimization
• In very rare cases, certain skills used in conjunction with others may cause issues – these are known, and will be fixed for launch.
• Delay in action after Always Hungry fails by about 10 seconds.
• Minor UI tweaks are in the works. 

You’re playing before launch – during crunch time – so there’s still work to be done. This is quite normal, so don’t feel as though this is indicative of the final quality of the game. If you encounter a problem, let us know, and we’ll get on it (it’s probably something we’re already working on).

For new players, a handy guide can be found here (this is not the final version): http://guide.bloodbowl-game.com/

If you encounter technical issues (no personal feedbacks), please post it on our dedicated forum: http://forum.bloodbowl-game.com/viewforum.php?f=90
To help us identify and fix them as fast as possible, make sure to include as many information, crash reports, replay, ... as possible.

That’s about all you need to know before jumping in – so, jump in!

Have fun,

Cyanide Studios & Focus Home Interactive.

notes.title: BLOOD BOWL 2: THE DARK ELVES' TRICK AND TREATS!
notes.notes:
[b][i]Blood Bowl 2: the Dark Elves' tricks & treats, in a gameplay video! [/i][/b]

After revealing more details with its [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=URMfC-scXF0]Overview Trailer[/url], Blood Bowl 2, the sequel to the video game adaptation of Games Workshop's famous board game that combines American football with the fantasy world of Warhammer, today exposes the match philosophy of the Dark Elves! 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=c9bZToLCm3A

Evil beyond belief, skilled without doubt, the Dark Elves take to the pitch to show the world their superiority. Dark Elf teams prefer a malevolent and spiteful running game over the passing of their goodly cousins. notes.title: BLOOD BOWL 2: SECOND GAMEPLAY VIDEO RELEASED FT. THE CHAOS!
notes.notes:
[b][i]The Chaos teams show-off their match philosophy. The Chaos theory turned to practice.[/i][/b]

After revealing a [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8-vhwFQkRP0]first gameplay video[/url] starring [url=http://bloodbowlgame.tumblr.com/post/114131540785/team-introduction-1-humans]the polyvalent Humans[/url], [b]Blood Bowl 2[/b], the sequel to the video game adaptation of [b]Games Workshop's famous board game[/b] that combines [b]American football[/b] with the [b]fantasy world of Warhammer[/b], today exposes a whole new match philosophy: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=131ti-NpUS0]that of the Chaos[/url]!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=131ti-NpUS0

While human teams are able to adapt to any kind of game – passing, running, or blocking – [b]Chaos teams[/b] have a natural predisposition to a certain type of play style when it comes to a [b]Blood Bowl[/b] match, favouring one very specific tactic amongst all: [i]crippling, maiming, injuring, trampling, and killing as many opponent players as possible[/i]. And, when only few or no survivors is left, they finally care about the ball to score a touchdown. However, do not believe that nimbler teams will have it easy weaving past and the punches: the Chaos teams are the only ones to have innate access, among all 75 skills in the game, to mutations. These mutations are not just bringing visual modifications on your players; they also bring meaningful advantages. They can, for example, increase their destruction potential, but also handicap the dodging, running or passing of more agile teams. If your wish is to unleash chaos on the field… well, then, the teams bearing the same name are made just for you. 

This video shows [b]Blood Bowl 2[/b]'s brand [b]new graphics engine[/b] in action, but also reveals the meticulous work done on [b]Blood Bowl 2[/b] by developer [b]Cyanide[/b] to capture the authentic [b]Blood Bowl[/b] experience: the cheering of the ravenous fans filling the huge stadiums to the brink, the animations, the dynamic cameras enhancing the brutal atmosphere of the matches, the "[i]Cabalvision[/i]" identity and the hilarious commenting duo, [b]Jim Johnson and Bob Bifford[/b]. We also get a first look at the new game's interface and much improved visual feedback, bringing a more modern, fresher look to Blood Bowl while improving clarity and comprehension of the action on the field. 

[b][u]We look forward to revealing more of Blood Bowl 2 for PlayStation 4, Xbox ONE and PC with additional info and more gameplay videos soon![/u][/b]

[b][i]Cyanide Studios & Focus Home Interactive.[/i][/b]
